page.overview:
Who is Toxo-Zombie?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Toxo-Zombies were introduced in 1992's Eco-Warriors subset of the Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: grey-purple skin; neon green helmet with broken red faceplate; light purple ripped shirt with neon green chest armor and right glove; light purple ripped pants with broken neon green belt; black and neon green boot on right leg.

Accessories: bright green Sludge Viper water cannon with black plunger; black figure stand. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/92/toxozombie.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/92/toxozombie.shtml Filecard]
